measurementNotes: Real movement. Steal/recapture cells sampled at tick boundaries, excluding neutral ownership and respawn grants; transfers neutralized within the same tick may be omitted. Grudge/candidate counts distinguish plan creation and continuation; within-decision identical slot/cell/interrupt/reason is counted once. No behavior tuning.
classificationRule: Exploratory directional signal only if at least 7/8 seed deltas share direction AND every leave-one-seed-out total retains that direction. Otherwise indistinguishable (not evidence of no effect). Counts, min/max, mean, median and sample SD are shown. No formal significance or generalization claimed from eight seeds.
episodeNotes: Uninterrupted expansion cohorts exclude ATTACK overrides but retain ESCAPE/RETURN. End-censored/replanned episodes separately counted. Rates per launch are descriptive over 120 s, not uncensored survival probabilities.
proximityNotes: Conditional on launch-time public target identity and existing territory; missing targets are excluded and their counts shown. Death distances include existing and pending line cells immediately before neutralization. Survived selection-distance cohorts avoid death-only conditioning. No hidden opponent heads/trails used in policy.

comparisons.interpretation: Exploratory directional consistency only; indistinguishable is not no effect.
